title: Luceras Legs and Tail
heading: Luceras: legs, paws and tail
lede: Stage 5 of 11, parts 3 to 5, second version. The paws are now the generated paws you liked, exactly their shape and size, with four toes and small blunt claws added on top (and a small dewclaw on each front wrist), sized down after your note. Every picture shows three versions through the same camera: 1 the generated model, 2 the current build, 3 your shaved clay. Judge shape only: do the legs, paws and tail read right? Approve, or say what needs work and in which view. Confirm notifies the orchestrator.
fallback: Approvals cannot be saved from this view; reply in chat.
compositeEmpty: Confirm closes the legs, paws and tail; the whole-body check comes next.
confirmed: Confirmed; the orchestrator files it and runs the whole-body check. Tell the orchestrator you confirmed.

fold.title: Decided by the pipeline owner
fold.text: The paws went through several wrong turns: builds that reshaped the foot made it boxy or swollen. The fix was to put the generated paws back exactly (every point identical to the generated model) and add only detail on top: shallow grooves between the toes and separate claw pieces, with the outline held within half a millimeter of the generated paw. The tail and forelegs were refined by separate Codex builders and merged; the hind legs above the paws come from the first hind-leg pass. Codex time for parts 3 to 5 about 7 hours, about 2.4M Codex tokens; my reading about 250K Claude tokens.

legs.name: Legs, paws and tail
legs.question: Do the legs, paws and tail read as your shaved clay?
judge: Side: the big hind thigh into the rump, knee, hock, long lower leg, as the clay?
Paws: four rounded toes with clefts, dark claws from the tips?
Forelegs: lean columns, elbow point, wrist, short bone into the paw?
Tail: thick root, steady taper, low curve, upward hook?
legs.note: Checked on every paw: four toes, four claws, no holes. The two holes and the fifth toe lump you found on the right front paw came from the generated paw and are fixed. Known and small: slight lips of skin under the outer hind claws at the close three-quarter view; toe grooves subtle at full-body size; muscle relief softer than the clay, as on the approved torso.
